quarterly_data.quarter: Shenling Environmental Systems results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Director and general manager Pan Zhanhua (2025 annual results briefing): the Chencun base (the convertible-bond project) is expected to start production in July 2027 and add about RMB 10 hundred million of output value at full output; the Gaozhou base is expected to start production in September 2026 and add about RMB 15 hundred million of output value at full output (output values are estimates that depend heavily on product mix). Board secretary Gu Jianbin said business growth comes mainly from digital / compute and power / energy, and that overseas business is the current expansion focus with smooth progress; CFO Chen Bihua said R&D focuses on DPC phase-change cooling for data centers, liquid-cooling temperature-control systems, nuclear-grade equipment, electrochemical energy-storage thermal management and ultra-low-humidity dehumidifiers for lithium-battery plants.
quarterly_data.figure: Gaozhou base from September 2026, about RMB 15 hundred million output value; Chencun base from July 2027, about RMB 10 hundred million
